name: design-engineer
description: Design engineering plugin — ships the design-engineer subagent: a React + TypeScript specialist that builds and maintains design systems (tokens, theming, primitive components and their APIs, variants and states, Storybook stories) for the applications built by the frontend-engineer plugin's agent. Bundles seven skills (design-systems, component-craft, css-craft, motion, interface-guidelines, storybook, frontend-perf). Requires the engineering plugin from the same marketplace — the agent preloads its craft skills.
